questions.stem: A 25-year-old patient presents with acute abdominal distension and bilious vomiting. He had an open appendectomy 2 years back via the Rutherford Morrison incision. After evaluating and performing imaging, a decision for exploratory laparotomy is made, suspecting intestinal obstruction. Which organ will be first visualized to know if this is a case of small bowel or large bowel obstruction?
